status: Camera and reference construction review; O1 geometry and physical performance are not yet qualified

paper.title: GelSight Baby Fin Ray: A Compact, Compliant, Flexible Finger with High-Resolution Tactile Sensing

reference_construction.structure: Hollow TPU 95A Fin Ray with rigid backing; unobstructed inner optical path
reference_construction.gel: Paper reports XP-565 parts A/B and LC1550 plasticizer in 1:10:3 proportions; verify current supplier instructions before adopting
reference_construction.mirror: 0.2 mm reflective PET sheet on the inner back surface
reference_construction.camera: Paper uses a Raspberry Pi Zero Spy Camera with nominal 120 degree FOV; this is not the selected O1 camera
reference_construction.lighting: Blue 2835 LEDs at the base, fluorescent gel sides and a yellow filter
reference_construction.software: Raspberry Pi capture and perspective warp of the mirror image

limits: Different finger geometry and material construction
Does not qualify the new ENPIRE geometry or 20 N force accuracy
No paper photograph or full paper is republished as new kit artwork

camera_candidate.name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 Wide, standard visible-light IR-cut variant
camera_candidate.connector: 15 conductors, 1 mm pitch FPC; product brief lists a 200 mm cable
camera_candidate.choice_reason: Official mechanical drawing and maintained Raspberry Pi capture interface; base mounting can keep the rigid electronics off the flexible sensing body
limits: Nominal FOV is not calibrated distortion or usable edge quality
Pupil location, focus across the folded path and actual body/connector seating require inspection
Different camera from the published Baby Fin Ray

verified_notes: Picamera2 RGB888 memory order is B,G,R and is suitable for OpenCV; do not assume its name means an R,G,B byte array.
Manual autofocus mode and LensPosition can freeze the lens; query the actual supported control range.
Exposure/gain/colour settings and frame timing need fixed recorded values for tactile comparison.
